def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return a permutation of xs whose order depends only on seed.

    The same xs and seed always give the same result. The result has the
    same elements as xs, with the same multiplicities. xs is not modified.
    No randomness source or other capability is used."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    post sorted(out) == sorted(xs)
    ex shuffled([], 1) == []
    ex shuffled([7], 3) == [7]
    ex sorted(shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 5)) == [1, 2, 3, 4]
    ex shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 5) == shuffled([1, 2, 3, 4], 5)
    modulus = 2147483648
    state = seed % modulus
    if state < 0:
        state += modulus
    out = xs.copy()
    i = out.len() - 1
    while i > 0:
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % modulus
        j = (state // 65536) % (i + 1)
        tmp = out[i]
        out[i] = out[j]
        out[j] = tmp
        i -= 1
    return out
